title: shell.footprint.uninstall result
description: What removing the integration bundle from a remote host did (P10). Only manifest-owned, unmodified files are removed; anything the user changed is a reported conflict and stays; ~/.nocx is never removed recursively. The two lists are root-relative paths — a conflict is information the user acts on, never an error to swallow.

removed.description: Root-relative paths removed, including the manifest itself. Empty when nothing was installed or everything had already gone.

conflicts.description: Root-relative paths the user modified since the install; left in place. Empty when every manifest-owned file was unmodified.
